title: Modul POS - Table Management (F&B) - Panduan Lengkap
description: Panduan lengkap mengelola meja di Mode B F&B mencakup table assignment, status tracking, occupancy management, table merge/split, dan performance analytics.
author: Tim GIMS

content.body: Table Management adalah fitur di Mode B (F&B/Restaurant) untuk mengelola meja, status occupancy, customer assignment, dan optimize seating. Interface visual floor plan menampilkan semua meja dengan real-time status updates.

Table Status Flow: ``` AVAILABLE (kosong) ↓ [Customer datang] ↓ OCCUPIED (customer duduk & order) ↓ [Selesai makan, bayar] ↓ PENDING_PAYMENT (waiting settlement) ↓ [Payment done, lepas meja] ↓ CLEANING (staff membersihkan) ↓ [Clean done] ↓ AVAILABLE (siap customer baru) ``` Also: - RESERVED: Table di-reserve untuk customer future - DIRTY: Table perlu dibersihkan (interim status) Table Status Details:
Status Meaning Actions
AVAILABLE Meja kosong, siap Assign customer, Reserve
OCCUPIED Customer duduk & order View order, Add item, Handle
PENDING_PAYMENT Selesai makan, bayar Process payment, Release
CLEANING Dibersihkan Mark clean
DIRTY Kotor, needs clean Call for cleaning
RESERVED Di-reserve View reservation, Release

items.title: Visual Floor Plan
items.body: Main View: - Bird's eye view layout restoran - Each meja shown as rectangular block - Color-coded by status: - GREEN: Available (kosong) - BLUE: Occupied (ada customer) - YELLOW: Pending payment (tunggu bayar) - GRAY: Reserved - RED: Dirty (needs clean) Table Block Display: Table 1: 4 seats, AVAILABLE Table 3: 2/4 Pax, 18 min, OCCUPIED Interactive: - Click table untuk view detail - Drag table (jika layout configurable) - Right-click untuk quick actions

items.title: Table Sections
items.body: Floor plan bisa divided into sections (areas): Example Layout: ``` FRONT SECTION [Table 1] [Table 2] [Table 3] [Table 4] [Table 5] [Table 6] BACK SECTION [Table 7] [Table 8] [Table 9] [Table 10] TERRACE [Table 11] [Table 12] [Table 13] ``` Benefit: - Server focus satu section - Section status summary - Workload balancing Configuration: - Admin setup sections - Assign sections ke servers - Section headers di display

items.title: Assign Table to Customer
items.body: Proses: 1. Customer Datang: - "Berapa orang? Meja untuk 2?" - Assess group size 2. Select Available Table: - Look di floor plan - Find available table (GREEN) - Consider: - Size: Capacity >= pax count - Location: Quiet vs central - Server availability 3. Assign Table: - Click table - Dialog muncul: - Table confirmation: "Table 3 (4 seats)" - Number of guests*: Input pax (default: 1) - Assign server (optional): Select server name - Special notes (optional): "Birthday", "VIP", etc - Click 'Confirm Assignment' 4. Table Status Update: - Table status → OCCUPIED (BLUE) - Display: Table 3 | 2 Pax | Time: 0 min - Timestamp assignment recorded - Order linked ke table 5. Next Step: - Server approach table - Present menu - Take order

items.title: Modify Table Assignment
items.body: Setelah customer duduk, bisa modify: 1. Change Pax Count: - Customer group grow/shrink - Click table → 'Edit' - Update pax: 2 → 4 - Save - Display update 2. Change Server: - Reassign ke server lain - Click table → 'Reassign Server' - Select new server - Old server notified - New server take over service 3. Add Note: - Click table → 'Add Note' - Input: "Birthday - surprise dessert" - Shared ko staff

items.title: Merge Tables (Large Group)
items.body: Customer group besar, combine 2+ tables. Proses: 1. Select Tables: - Holding 8 people, need 2 tables - Click table 3 (first) - Hold Shift, click table 4 (second) - Both highlight (both select) 2. Merge Option: - Right-click → 'Merge Tables' - Or click 'Merge' button - Dialog: "Merge Table 3 + Table 4?" - Click 'Confirm' 3. System Execute: - Tables merged logically (linked) - Both display same order - One master table (3) untuk control - Child table (4) show "Merged ke Table 3" - Single seat count (4 + 4 = 8 seats) - Single bill (or split option) 4. Order Management: - Order applies to entire merged group - Kitchen see: "Merged Table 3+4, 8 Pax" - Settlement: Single bill atau split - Release: Both tables released together Unmerge: - After payment/guest leave - System auto-unmerge - Tables available separately

items.title: Split Bill (Separate Payment)
items.body: Customer want separate bills (e.g., business meeting, split cost). Proses: 1. Create Split Order: - Add items normally - When settle: Click 'Split Bill' - Dialog: "How many splits?" - Input: 2 splits (for 2 payers) 2. Assign Items to Splits: - Display: Item list dengan checkbox per split - Assign items: - Split 1: Steak, Drink - Split 2: Salad, Dessert - System calculate per-split total 3. Process Payments Separately: - Settle split 1: Steak + Drink = Rp 150.000 - Customer 1 bayar - Order status: Partial paid - Settle split 2: Salad + Dessert = Rp 80.000 - Customer 2 bayar - Order status: Fully paid 4. Receipt: - 2 separate receipts (one per split) - Linked ke original order - For accounting

items.title: Release Table (Finish Service)
items.body: Customer selesai, meja dilepas. Proses: 1. Payment Done: - Settlement completed - Order status: PAID/COMPLETED 2. Release Table: - Click table → 'Release Table' - Or click 'Release' button - Dialog: "Release table?" - Option: Mark dirty atau clean 3. System Update: - Table status → AVAILABLE (jika clean) - Or DIRTY (jika need clean) - Order final status: COMPLETED - Duration recorded: e.g., "Seated 45 min" 4. Table Ready: - Table available untuk next customer - History: Customer, duration, revenue - Server can take next customer

items.title: Clean Table
items.body: After customer leave, prepare table untuk guest baru. Workflow: 1. Table Released (DIRTY): - Table status: DIRTY / CLEANING - Appear red di floor plan 2. House Keeping Staff: - Take cloth, clean table - Check seat conditions - Refill condiments - Set table untuk next customer - ~5-10 min typically 3. Mark Clean: - Staff click table → 'Mark Clean' - Or click 'Clean' button - Dialog: "Table ready?" - Click 'Confirm' - Table status → AVAILABLE (GREEN) 4. Next Customer: - Table appear available - Greeter seat next customer - Cycle repeat

items.title: Reservation Management
items.body: Reserve table untuk future customer. Proses: 1. Reserve Table: - Click available table - Click 'Reserve' - Dialog: - Customer name* - Party size* - Reservation time*: e.g., "19:00" - Phone: Contact customer - Notes: "VIP", "Birthday", etc - Click 'Reserve' 2. Table Status: - Table → RESERVED (GRAY) - Display: "Reserved - John Doe, 4pax, 19:00" - Not available untuk other customers 3. At Reservation Time: - Customer arrive - Staff: "Hi, I see reservation for John" - Click 'Confirm Arrival' - Table → OCCUPIED - Proceed normal service 4. No-Show Handling: - If customer not arrive by 19:30 (buffer) - Staff click 'Release Reservation' - Table → AVAILABLE - Note: "No-show at 19:00" - Can offer table to walk-in 5. Cancel Reservation: - Customer call: "Can't make it" - Staff cancel reservation - Table → AVAILABLE - Note: "Cancelled by customer"

items.title: Real-Time Occupancy
items.body: Manager dapat monitor table occupancy in real-time. Dashboard: - Total tables: 12 - Occupied: 8 - Available: 3 - Dirty/Cleaning: 1 - Reserved: 0 Occupancy Rate: - Current: 66% (8 of 12) - Average today: 58% - Peak: 85% (at 19:30) Wait List: - Customers waiting: 2 - Est. wait: 15 min (next table release) - Alert: High occupancy, walk-in queue building

items.title: Table Performance Metrics
items.body: Per-Table Analytics: 1. Turn-Around Time: - Avg time customer seated to left - Example: Table 3 avg 42 min - Benchmark: Fast service = 30-40 min - Identify: Slow service table (if > 60 min) 2. Revenue per Table: - Total revenue from table today - Example: Table 3 = Rp 450.000 (lunch) + Rp 300.000 (dinner) - Per-turn: Rp 375.000 average 3. Turnover Rate: - How many times table used per service - Example: Lunch 3 turns, Dinner 2 turns = 5 turns/day - Benchmark: Good = 4-5 turns/service 4. Peak Usage: - Which tables busiest? - Which tables least used? - Reposition seating for optimization Daily Report: ``` TABLE PERFORMANCE - May 5, 2026 Table 1 │ 4 covers │ 175 min │ Rp 750K │ 2.6 turns │ Efficient Table 2 │ 3 covers │ 240 min │ Rp 600K │ 1.5 turns │ Slow Table 3 │ 5 covers │ 210 min │ Rp 1.1M │ 2.3 turns │ Good ```

content.body: 1. Optimal Seating: - Match table size to party (not too big, not squished) - Prevent overload (rushing food) - Improve comfort (higher satisfaction) 2. Server Assignments: - Balance workload (1-2 servers per section) - Consistent server throughout meal (better service) - Train floating server untuk assist 3. Table Cleaning: - Clean immediately after customer leave - Don't let tables stay dirty - Quick turnaround = higher revenue 4. Reservation Confirmation: - Confirm reservation day before (reduce no-show) - Have buffer table (for walk-in) - Manage expectations on wait time 5. Occupancy Management: - Monitor occupancy rate - Adjust staffing based on demand - Track bottleneck (slow tables) 6. Customer Feedback: - Note special requests/preferences - Follow up ("Did you enjoy?") - Use feedback untuk improve service
